name: BEIR SciFact fixed functional subset
license_or_usage_note: SciFact is imported only as a fixed, attribution-preserving public text-retrieval diagnostic subset. The Hugging Face dataset card lists CC BY-SA 4.0; retain its license and source attribution when redistributing derived artifacts.

selection.algorithm: deterministically order positive-qrel test queries by SHA-256(seed, query_id); include all positive documents first, then fill remaining bounded corpus slots with deterministically ordered non-relevant documents

scope_boundary: This scorecard exercises title/abstract text retrieval only.
It does not evaluate PDF parsing, layout handling, page citations, answer generation, or RAG faithfulness.
It is diagnostic and must not be reported as a Golden result or a production benchmark.
